note: Fully serviced campground in the woods a short walk from the Waskesiu townsite in Prince Albert National Park, built for large RVs and trailers. Check in at the campground kiosk (mid-June to Labour Day); in spring and fall check in at Beaver Glen or the Visitor Centre. Open fires are not permitted; propane fire pits are. --Claude
summary: Keep. 161 full-hookup pull-throughs, 100% reservable via Parks Canada, $43.75/$47.25 (2026 fees page), season mid-May to mid-October (hours page), 2026 electrical upgrade with spring/fall closures. Not waterfront confirmed; pin on the loops' NE edge, no move.
